notes.material: Every imported opaque pixel is sampled from a saved built-in image-generation PNG; no procedural anatomy is added to these source frames.
notes.timing: The source cartridge animation lists, frame counts, timing and intentional blanks are preserved. Repeated source poses retain native phase slots; only full-frame mirroring is used.
notes.coverage: Only generated poses with matching visible action and direction are mapped. Unmapped roles remain the earlier artwork and are enumerated in coverage.json. This is a partial raster migration.
notes.nativeMirrors: Right-facing roles mirror the generated left-facing pixels to use native tile sharing. Explicit source-right drawings remain archived for review.
notes.missingSources: Every native nonblank frame has a matching generated role. All254native frames, including the one intentional blank, require exact native upload verification before activation.
orientationCorrections: Base cell12 battle guard faces right and is mirrored for left. Story cell15 looks right and is mirrored for the opposite look phase.
Directions cell13 rear look faces right; mirrored for the left-head-turn phase.
notes.castReuse: Side casting, big-cast and casting-walk share the generated profile casting step with the forward boot planted; rear casting now uses the separate raised-hands rear source. Native timing is unchanged.
notes.proportions: Native30pixel ordinary standing height with full-silhouette32pixel exceptions; complete PNG silhouettes remain inside the native32×32 frame.
notes.derivedSequences: Rear draw progresses from source rear idle to actual polearm guard and wind-up. Rear swing uses generated wind-up, full follow-through and guard. Rear blink reuses rear idle because the eyes are hidden from behind; side blink visibly closes its eye while retaining the generated folded-arm stance.
